categories.name: SPL22
categories.content: SPL22 is a hybrid token extension of the Solana blockchain that combines the features of both fungible and non-fungible tokens.

categories.name: Sun Pump Ecosystem
categories.content: Sun Pump Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via sunpump.meme.

categories.name: daos.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: daos.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens that have active hedge funds on daos.fun.

categories.name: Tourism
categories.content: A coin or token that leverages blockchain technology to improve various aspects of the tourism industry.

categories.name: Printr Launchpad
categories.content: Printr is chain-abstracted token launchpad with customizable fee models and an on-chain 'Proof of Belief' staking mechanism that rewards long-term community commitment.

categories.name: Tokenized Closed-End Funds (CEFs)
categories.content: Tokens representing shares of closed-end funds (CEFs), a typed of pooled investment vehicle that raises capital once and issue a fixed number of shares, with no ongoing creation or redemption mechanism. Tokenized CEFs are issued by a tokenization platform that holds the listed fund shares in custody and mints tokens against them, so the token inherits the fund's market price rather than its NAV.

categories.name: Zora Creator
categories.content: Zora Creator Coins are profile-level tokens on the Zora platform, a blockchain-based social network focused on the creator economy. Each Zora account has its own unique Creator Coin, represented by the user's username as the ticker symbol (e.g., $username).

categories.name: Pools Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Pools (https://pools.trade/), Uniswap's first-party token issuance platform.

categories.name: Ondo Intelligent Portfolios
categories.content: Single-token portfolio products issued by Ondo Finance that bundle multiple tokenized assets into one on-chain instrument. Each portfolio packages a themed basket that is drawn from Ondo's tokenized equities, ETFs, and in some cases crypto assets.

categories.name: TRON Meme
categories.content: Meme coins native to the TRON network.

categories.name: ERC 404
categories.content: ERC-404 is an experimental token standard that aims to bridge fungible tokens and NFTs to enable liquidity and fractionalization.

categories.name: Cookie Launchpad
categories.content: Cookie Launchpad is a token sale platform operated by Cookie DAO that allocates participation opportunities in three pools: one for top users ranked by on-chain and social engagement ('capital mindshare' via Cookie Snaps), one for $COOKIE token stakers in higher tiers, and a public first-come-first-served pool.

categories.name: Backpack Securities Ecosystem
categories.content: Backpack Securities is a platform by Backpack that allows users to trade real U.S. stocks through traditional brokerage infrastructure and convert them into tokenized securities on Solana for 24/7 DeFi-compatible trading.

categories.name: NFT Strategy Flywheel
categories.content: The NFT Strategy Flywheel is a DeFi-NFT hybrid model that automates NFT accumulation and token burning using trading fees to drive continuous buy pressure and value accrual for token holders.

categories.name: Camelot Launchpad
categories.content: Camelot Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: NFTStrategy Ecosystem
categories.content: NFTStrategy is an automated protocol that converts crypto trading fees into buying and selling floor NFTs, creating a self-sustaining value loop for NFT collections.

categories.name: Moonshot Ecosystem
categories.content: Moonshot Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via https://moonshot.money/.

categories.name: IP
categories.content: Intellectual property (IP) related crypto projects leverage blockchain technology to tokenize and manage intellectual property, enabling transparent ownership, automated royalties, and decentralized marketplaces for creators and investors.

categories.name: Kommunitas Launchpad
categories.content: Kommunitas Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.
